evidence.reason: Changed metering.initialize() to metering.reset() and plan "monthly" to "benchly"; tests assert evaluate(20,0.1,"monthly") > 0 and subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, so the plan string change may alter expected pricing behavior.

Added early return for units===0 and introduced undefined variable u in `if (u< 0)`, which would throw ReferenceError instead of the expected RangeError for negative units, breaking assert.throws(() => evaluate(-1,0.1,"monthly"), RangeError).
Tests rely on evaluate(20,0.1,"monthly") > 0, RangeError for negative units, and subscriptionCharge(40) > 0; both edits jointly threaten these assertions.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改共同改变了订阅计费的初始化、计划标识和负值校验，可能破坏现有测试对月度计费与 RangeError 的预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/metering.ts#usageCharge，将 `if (u< 0)` 更正为 `if (units < 0)`，并确认 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 中 plan 参数应保持 "monthly" 还是有意改为 "benchly"。
